frameworks_concepts.name: Build phase to deployment phase
frameworks_concepts.summary: Mui and Kennedy frame AI's shift from infrastructure build-out toward inference deployment and real enterprise use.

frameworks_concepts.name: Consumer surplus capture
frameworks_concepts.summary: If all firms adopt AI without a moat, the economic surplus flows to consumers rather than corporate profits.

frameworks_concepts.name: Sum-of-the-parts valuation
frameworks_concepts.summary: BI values SpaceX by segment: ~$400B xAI + ~$600B satellites + ~$1.2T launch.

frameworks_concepts.name: Self-perpetuating AI ecosystem
frameworks_concepts.summary: AI capex becomes sustainable only when enterprise users generate profits that flow back up the stack.

frameworks_concepts.name: Price-to-sales multiple
frameworks_concepts.summary: Used to expose how lofty SpaceX (~96x) and Rocket Lab (~90x) valuations are vs ~10x software norms.

frameworks_concepts.name: Embodied AI
frameworks_concepts.summary: AI operating in the unstructured physical world, where dexterity and real-time reasoning are the differentiators.
